name: Juicy soy-glaze chicken breast strips (חזה עוף עסיסי וטעים)

source.author: Instagram — @lichtenstadt (Hebrew caption screenshot)
source.notes: Analyzed from the pasted Hebrew caption (full marinade list + method; method text cut off at 'don't leave the pan' = stir/fry a few min per side). Chicken exact at 1 kg; frying oil (~1 tbsp) assumed since 'a little olive oil' isn't quantified. Per-serving assumes most of the marinade glazes onto the chicken — if you drain the bowl before frying, subtract ~2–3 g fat and ~150 mg sodium/serving. Cornflour is the 'magic' moisture-lock coating.

serving_desc: ≈160 g cooked (1 kg raw chicken batch ÷5)

ingredients.note: cut into uniform plump strips — VARIABLE input; scale marinade with it

steps: Cut chicken breast into uniform plump strips.
Mix all marinade ingredients until smooth; coat the chicken and mix well.
Heat a pan with a little olive oil; fry the strips a few minutes per side until done, stirring/attending constantly (don't leave the pan).

him.verdict: A genuinely strong high-protein main — 46 g protein for ~380 kcal (~12 g protein per 100 kcal), lean chicken kept juicy by the cornflour trick (smart: moisture without much cost). Two levers to watch, both easy: SODIUM is high (~830 mg/serving from 3 tbsp soy + ½ tsp salt + sweet chili), and fat is moderate (~17 g) because the marinade carries 3 tbsp olive oil + sesame oil on top of the frying oil. Added sugar is modest (~5 g/serving from maple + sweet chili).
flags: fat driven by marinade oils (~17 g)
suggested_mods: Use low-sodium soy or cut it to 2 tbsp — biggest sodium lever
Halve the marinade olive oil (1.5 tbsp) — it's mostly flavor/coating; saves ~5 g fat/serving with little loss
Serve over a big salad or veg to add the fiber/micros the dish itself lacks

her_preconception.verdict: Good lean protein + choline (~128 mg) and selenium for her, fully cooked so no safety flags. The main caution is sodium (~830 mg/serving) — worth easing in pregnancy. Ginger in culinary amounts is fine (even mildly helpful for nausea). Not a big micronutrient contributor otherwise — pair with veg/greens.
prenatal_highlights: choline (~128 mg) + selenium from the chicken

safety_advisories.note: High sodium (~830 mg/serving) — ease it in pregnancy (low-sodium soy, less salt).

suggested_mods: Serve with greens/legumes for folate + iron
Ginger is fine in these culinary amounts

adopted_note: Adopted into the rotation 2026-08-22 as a high-protein chicken main. Scales with chicken weight (marinade scales alongside). Standing guidance: use low-sodium soy / cut salt (base recipe is ~830 mg sodium/serving), and consider halving the marinade olive oil to trim fat. Per-serving reference: ~380 kcal, 46 g protein per ~160 g (1 kg raw chicken ÷5).
